title: A frequently-retrieved fact outranks an equal-trust, never-retrieved rival
description: Proves retrieval-frequency reinforcement end-to-end through the exact fact search tool: two facts with identical trust and equivalent query relevance are distinguished only after the hot fact is recalled through that same tool.
contract_notes: Deterministic, no LLM. Both facts share every query-matching token and are seeded at trust 0.6. The hot fact is recalled through the exact search route before the ranking assertion, so no test-only store mutation supplies usage state.
